examples.arabic: كلنا تعلمنا درس مهم: لما نتعاون ونخطط سوا، بنقدر نواجه أصعب التحديات اللي بتجينا بالحياة.
examples.english: We all learned an important lesson: when we cooperate and plan together, we can face the toughest challenges that come our way in life.
examples.transliteration: Kullna ta'allamna dars muhimm: lamma neta'aawan w nkhattet sawah, benqdar nwaaje' as'ab et-tahaddiyat illi b-tejeena bil-haya.
examples.storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

examples.arabic: لحد ما يصير هاد، الناس هون عم يثبتوا إنو الحياة بتكمل بالحب والتعاون.
examples.english: Until that happens, the people here are proving that life continues with love and cooperation.
examples.transliteration: La-hadd ma ysir hada, el-naas haun am yit-hbitu innu el-hayat btikammel bel-hubb wal-ta-awun.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: هيك قصص بتعطينا أمل إنه الحياة لازم تستمر رغم الحروب.
examples.english: Such stories give us hope that life must continue despite wars.
examples.transliteration: Heik qisas bitatina amal inno el hayat lazem tustamir raghm el huroub.
examples.storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

examples.arabic: كان سامي، الخباز القديم، بيقضي نهاره بوسط الردم بمدينة حلب وهو عم يحاول يرجع الحياة لمخبزه الصغير يلي تهدم نصه.
examples.english: Sami, the old baker, was spending his day in the middle of the rubble in Aleppo city, trying to bring life back to his small bakery, half of which was destroyed.
examples.transliteration: Kan Sami, al-khabbaz al-qadim, biyaqdi naharo bi-wasat al-radm bi-madinat Halab wa-huwa am yuhawil yarajji al-hayat li-makhbazo al-saghir yalli thaddam nusso.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: الكبار في السن يتحدثون عن قيم الاصالة وعادات الزمن الجميل وتحديات الحياة المعاصرة التي لم تكن موجودة بعهدهم
examples.english: The elders speak of the values of authenticity and the customs of the beautiful past, and the challenges of modern life that did not exist in their era.
examples.transliteration: Al-kbaar fis-sinn yethaaddasoo an qiyam al-asala wa 'aadāt iz-zaman il-jameel wa tahaddiyaat il-hayaat il-mu'aasira illi ma kaanat mawjooda bi-ahd-hum.

examples.arabic: السوق كان مليان ناس والجو كان مفعم بالحياة
examples.english: The market was full of people and the atmosphere was vibrant with life.
examples.transliteration: Es-souq kan malyan nas w el-jaw kan muf'am bil-haya.
